summary: Cipher Digital (CIFR) filed an 8-K announcing a private Rule 144A offering of $850M 0.00%? convertible senior notes due 2032, with a 13-day option for an additional $150M. Concurrently, Cipher expects privately negotiated exchanges of a portion of its 1.75% Convertible Senior Notes due 2030 for common stock (Concurrent 2030 Notes Exchange). No price, premium, or advisor was disclosed. The offering and exchange are subject to market conditions. Watch for final coupon, conversion premium, exchange ratio, and any deleveraging or dilution overhang from the exchange, which may create arbitrage pressure tied to the underlying equity.
